name: derives visible items and clears a filtered-out selection
input: a wide workspace whose selected item no longer matches the query
test:
state = {
    'width': 800,
    'sidebar_open': True,
    'query': '',
    'selected_id': 'alpha',
    'items': [
        {'id': 'alpha', 'label': 'Alpha notes'},
        {'id': 'beta', 'label': 'Build docs'},
        {'id': 'gamma', 'label': 'Gamma'},
    ],
}
result = reduce_layout_state(state, {'type': 'set_query', 'query': 'DOC'})
assert result['layout'] == 'wide'
assert result['visible_ids'] == ['beta']
assert result['selected_id'] is None
assert state['query'] == '' and state['selected_id'] == 'alpha'
assert result['items'] == state['items'] and result['items'] is not state['items']

name: applies selection, resize, and sidebar actions as pure transitions
input: a compact transition after selecting a visible workspace item
test:
state = {
    'width': 900,
    'sidebar_open': True,
    'query': 'doc',
    'selected_id': None,
    'items': [{'id': 'a', 'label': 'Architecture docs'}, {'id': 'b', 'label': 'Roadmap'}],
}
selected = reduce_layout_state(state, {'type': 'select', 'id': 'a'})
resized = reduce_layout_state(selected, {'type': 'resize', 'width': 600})
toggled = reduce_layout_state(resized, {'type': 'toggle_sidebar'})
assert selected['selected_id'] == 'a' and selected['visible_ids'] == ['a']
assert resized['layout'] == 'compact' and resized['sidebar_open'] is True
assert toggled['sidebar_open'] is False and toggled['selected_id'] == 'a'
